name: manual_feb99d
claim: A reciprocal peer-delivery claim requires a verified peer CA and a receiver receipt whose LF-normalised content hash matches the sender; a CA pin mismatch blocks every bearer-bearing retry.

decisions.notes: Verified across the two-way canary recovery: authenticated delivery was withheld until a peer CA pin was independently checked, and receiver acceptance plus normalized-content receipt remained the only evidence of delivery. This preserves fail-closed bearer transport and prevents sender-only completion claims.
